name: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd.
blurb: ASE Technology is the world's largest OSAT (outsourced semiconductor assembly and test) company, responsible for packaging and testing chips after they leave the foundry wafer fab. Chip packaging — the process of cutting wafers into individual dies, mounting them in substrates, and connecting them to the outside world — is increasingly strategic as advanced packaging (chiplets, CoWoS, SoIC) becomes essential for AI accelerators that exceed the reticle size limits of individual dies. ASE's CoWoS-compatible packaging capacity has become a key bottleneck in NVIDIA Blackwell GPU supply chains. ASE is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan.
recent: ASE has benefited from surging demand for advanced packaging from AI chip supply chains. NVIDIA's Blackwell GPUs require CoWoS advanced packaging, a significant portion of which flows through ASE and its competitor SPIL (a subsidiary). Forward P/E of ~47.4x on 39.7% projected EPS growth yields a PEG of 1.19. Revenue growth is driven by advanced packaging volumes rather than legacy wire-bond assembly.
